army_rules.name: Combat Doctrines
army_rules.rules_text:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase. Unless otherwise stated, you can only select each combat doctrine once per battle, and only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for it is no longer active for that unit.

ASSAULT DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make an Advance move, that Advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE: This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

TACTICAL DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, that Fall Back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.

army_rules.name: Transhuman Strategist
army_rules.rules_text: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

army_rules.name: Space Marine Chapters
army_rules.rules_text: If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit's Chapter. You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

army_rules.name: Special Move Types
army_rules.rules_text:
SHOCK DISEMBARK MOVE: Set-up distance 3". An eligible embarked unit that did not embark this phase can disembark wholly within 3" of its Transport, but cannot declare a charge until the end of the turn.

ASSAULT DISEMBARK MOVE: Set-up distance 3". An eligible embarked unit that did not embark this phase can disembark wholly within 3" of its Transport if that Transport has not Advanced or Fallen Back this phase.

army_rules.name: Heirs of Sigismund
army_rules.rules_text: Your army cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER models. Your army cannot include the following datasheets from Codex: Space Marines: GLADIATOR LANCER, GLADIATOR REAPER, GLADIATOR VALIANT, IMPULSOR, REPULSOR, REPULSOR EXECUTIONER.

chapter_rules.name: Heirs of Sigismund
chapter_rules.rules_text: Black Templars armies cannot include ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER models or the restricted Gladiator, Impulsor and Repulsor datasheets.

stratagems.name: Slayers of Abominations
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S.

stratagems.name: Unsparing Execution
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, that enemy unit must use the Desperate Escape mode, with -1 to those Hazard rolls if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Blade of Detestation
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
